company.name: Hoop.dev
company.shortDescription: Hoop.dev provides secure access gateway controlling infrastructure, masking data, and automating compliance workflows.
company.description: Hoop.dev creates ad-hoc database and container access with SSO and auditing. They improve autonomy through security while safeguarding personal information. Database responsibilities for PII columns and ETL procedures to create sensitive columns are replaced. By restricting access to personally identifying information, they increase end users' privacy.

productsAndServices.description: A platform that provides secure, just-in-time privileged access to databases and servers, replacing shared credentials and manual approvals with automated policies and session recording.
productsAndServices.name: Privileged Access Management Platform

productsAndServices.description: A service that uses machine learning to automatically identify and redact sensitive data in real-time across database and Kubernetes connections without manual policy configuration.
productsAndServices.name: AI-Powered Real-Time Data Masking

productsAndServices.description: Tools including an AI Copilot and AI Query Builder that assist developers in building queries and scripts securely within their existing workflows.
productsAndServices.name: Developer Tools with AI Assistance

productsAndServices.description: Automation features that transform manual security processes into automated workflows using integrated runbooks and GitOps practices.
productsAndServices.name: Infrastructure Automation with Runbooks and GitOps

productsAndServices.description: A system that records all access sessions and logs commands and queries to provide full visibility for security audits and investigations.
productsAndServices.name: Session Recording and Audit Logging
